item.title: Christians in Iran imprisoned over affiliation with 'Zionist Christianity' activities deemed against Islam

item.title: ‘Iran’s in big trouble,’ Trump warns as world watches for signs of collapse

item.title: 5 things to know about the late Michael Reagan: 'I was a chosen one'

item.title: Trump's week in review: Venezuela oil deal, Hyde Amendment backlash
item.description: The first week of 2026 brought multiple developments in foreign and domestic policy, with the capture of Venezuelan dictator Nicolas Maduro dominating the headlines. Other news that broke involved tensions between President Donald Trump and pro-life activists over his comments about the Hyde Amendment and abortion funding. The administration also announced efforts to reduce the cost of homeownership and combat fraud. #Trump #Venezuela #Maduro #Greenland #JDVance #HydeAmendment
